attempts.text:
**The window starts on a single spine column.** Column 0, `yciO`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls, and the model names it in 99% of genomes at 0.18 bits. Then the graph opens: columns 1 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 32% of calls.

**The first fork is at `rnm`**, and the `trp` genes follow, [[tryptophan biosynthesis]], carried by 88% of chromosomes. A second branch runs through columns 1 to 27, 27 families at 10 to 12%, from `yciQ` to `fabI`, with `rluB`, `cobO` and `topA` among them. The model names genes in 62 to 100% of genomes here, fewest at column 22, `oppD`, 62%.

**The `opp` operon sits in the middle**, [[oligopeptide transport]], columns 21 to 25, and the most hesitant column of the window is column 26, a hypothetical protein, at 1.26 bits. A second branch of 20 families, `sapF` to `pspE`, runs through columns 29 to 48, and the `nar` genes, [[nitrate reduction]], follow at columns 37 to 43. The model hesitates more inside a region of plasticity than outside: 1.78 against 0.20 bits, and names 65% against 96%.

**The window ends in variable columns.** Columns 49 to 51 and 55 to 58 are variable, and the last stretch runs from `ispE` to `ycgB`, ending at column 79, `ycgB`, in 35% of chromosomes. A second branch of 6 families, from an iron ABC transporter substrate-binding protein to a TonB-dependent siderophore receptor, runs through columns 69 to 74 at 19 to 21%. Across the window the model names 90% of genes at 0.53 bits.

label: yciO
facts:
WINDOW: the yciO window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yciO, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,420 to 2,499 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yciO once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 90% of genes, 0.53 bits on average (perplexity 1.7 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 31,980 calls, named 97%, 0.16 bits; shell 9,659 calls, named 76%, 1.21 bits; cloud 1,561 calls, named 16%, 3.85 bits. Outside an RGP 34,213 calls, named 96%, 0.20 bits; inside an RGP 8,987 calls, named 65%, 1.78 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 67 fork, 12 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.78 against 0.20 bits) and names fewer genes (65% against 96%); 8,987 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 26 ("hypothetical protein") 1.26 bits, RGP 22%; column 11 (ompW) 1.18 bits, RGP 14%; column 17 (kch) 1.06 bits, RGP 25%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 0-32%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: yciO "L-threonylcarbamoyladenylate syntha…". named 99%; 0.18 bits.
2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 0-32%. named 62-100% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 22, named 62%; most hesitant at column 26, 1.26 bits.
   a second branch of 27 families through columns 1-27, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-12%, 25 P, 2 S; the branch's families: yciQ, rluB, cobO, yciK, sohB, yciN, topA, cysB, ymiA, yciX, ymiC, acnA, ribA, pgpB, lapA, lapB, pyrF, yciH, osmB, yciT, yciZ, ymiD, pdeR, "hypothetical protein", rnb, yciW, fabI
